evidence.text: Pieces 八 being further subdivided with a knife 刀
Depicts a knife ( 刀 ) being used to cut two things apart (八).
別也。从八从刀，刀以分別物也。
Ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意): 八 (“to separate”) + 刀 (“knife”) – to separate with a knife.
